subject: SOC 2 Type II report & TrustBridge access — next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@kestrel.health>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kestrel.health>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 / HIPAA questions

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning — the demo helped a lot. Two quick asks as we scope procurement and our security review: could you share your latest SOC 2 Type II report (or anticipated availability window) and any bridge letter we can present to our security committee in the interim? Also we need to kick off the vendor security questionnaire and get temporary TrustBridge access to retrieve artifacts (system diagrams, access logs).

We are evaluating for a pilot in Q3 (PHI scope across a single product line) so HIPAA alignment and data residency notes would be helpful.

Attaching our security intake spreadsheet to help capture dependencies — I labelled the rows where we need a file or attestation.

Next step from our side: Tom will coordinate legal & procurement and circle back on timelines.

Thanks,
Aisha Kumar
Director, Security & Privacy
Kestrel Health

Attachment: Kestrel_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@kestrel.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai; jordan_blake@redwood.ai; Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kestrel.health>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 / HIPAA questions

Hi Aisha — really glad the demo was useful. Quick reply with concrete next steps so your team can plan: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: We have a completed Type II for the period ending 2027-12-31. For customers in pilot we can provide the report under NDA. Ben, can you start the NDA/DSA loop with Kestrel?

2) Bridge letter: I attached a current bridge letter that covers the gap between the 2027 audit and our ongoing 2028 audits. It includes scope notes for our hosted API and dedicated offerings and clarifies that no customer data was included in the audit scope.

3) TrustBridge access: We can provision a temporary TrustBridge read-only account scoped to Kestrel's artifacts. Jordan, can you create a portal invite scoped to the ticketed artifacts Aisha referenced (system diagram, network controls, change log extract)?

4) VSQ / questionnaire: Please populate the spreadsheet you sent. If you prefer, we can also complete the highlighted rows and return them as an exported XLSX.

5) HIPAA/data residency: Short answer — our hosted offering supports regional controls and we have a HIPAA attestation process and BAAs for customers who need them. I can include a short note from Legal.

Proposed timeline: NDA + portal invite within 48 hours; SOC 2 delivery after NDA execute (we provide secure link); bridge letter attached now.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_BridgeLetter_2028.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@kestrel.health>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; jordan_blake@redwood.ai; Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kestrel.health>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 / HIPAA questions

Hi Aisha — I started the NDA and DPA paperwork with our Legal team; you should get an initial DocuSign packet from legal@redwood.ai in the next business day. Linking our mutual action plan here so we have a shared set of milestones: 1) NDA signed, 2) TrustBridge access provisioned, 3) SOC 2 link provided, 4) BAA executed if PHI in scope, 5) pilot kickoff.

If it's helpful I'll run a short intro call between Kestrel procurement and our contracts lead — open to Tue/Wed next week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Related link: https://app.docusign.com/initiations/REDW-nda-kestrel

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@kestrel.health>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai; Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kestrel.health>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: TrustBridge invite + artifact plan

Hi Aisha — I created the read-only TrustBridge workspace for Kestrel this morning and invited the address sec-ops@kestrel.health. The invite link is: https://trustbridge.redwood-inference.com/kestrel/portal-invite/ABCD1234 (valid for 7 days).

Artifacts I uploaded to the workspace: system-architecture-v2.pdf, access-control-matrix.csv (redacted), change-log-sample.txt. I flagged a network diagram as "sensitive" — will only be visible after NDA is signed.

A few notes: the access logs we can export for a 90-day window; if you need longer retention we can schedule an evidence export. Also, the bridge letter in the portal is the same as the attached PDF Kimberly sent.

If you run into permissions issues, reply and I'll escalate.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Security & Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Attachment (portal): system-architecture-v2.pdf (read-only), access-control-matrix.csv (redacted)

From: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@kestrel.health>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai; jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge invite + artifact plan

Thanks everyone — I can confirm our sec-ops alias received the portal invite and can see the non-sensitive artifacts. Tom and I reviewed the bridge letter and it fits our immediate needs for internal review.

Action items we have: 1) sign NDA & DPA (Tom will coordinate contract questions), 2) Kimberly to share the HIPAA attestation / BAA process doc, 3) Redwood to return the completed rows in our questionnaire for system-level answers (we'll track the remaining items).

Tom will add a procurement contact to this thread once he has the legal packet review notes.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this helps speed our pilot approval cadence.

Best,
Aisha
